cuts.dialogue:
구릉 출발 전 확인!
여기 주특입 룰 맞죠?
cuts.visual_prompt: Medium three-quarter shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background with only a minimal cracked dungeon stone floor patch under their feet. On the left, Troll Shaman (she/her, wooden totem staff cleanly stowed on her back) leans forward raising one index finger attentively; on the right, Undead Paladin tank (she/her, carrying a sturdy golden-trimmed shield and one-handed mace) gives a lazy half-lidded nod.

어 이거 보기특 템인데?

cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic medium action shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. On the left, Undead Paladin tank (she/her, golden shield strapped to one arm and single one-handed golden mace tucked at her side) casually tosses a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube die with round dot pips only (no digits) with one hand while dangling a delicate thin necklace with a glowing green teardrop emerald amulet pendant in her other hand; on the right, Troll Shaman (she/her, single wooden totem staff stowed on back) freezes mid-step in utter shock.

Extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of the frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Centered Troll Shaman (she/her) stares dead-center with wide blank white eyes, jaw dropped wide open, and a tiny cute cartoonish white ghost soul floating upward out of her mouth in speechless disbelief.
